title: Tech Note: Dynamic Print Selection Using 4D Write Pro (Revised Jan 5th, 2023)
author: Add Komoncharoensiri, Director of Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: WP Insert table / WP Table get cells / WP SET ATTRIBUTES
WP New header / WP New footer

historical_commentary.text: 4D Write Pro has fully superseded classic 4D Write as 4D's document engine, and this note's approach — binding WP tables to ORDA entity selections via Formula()/This.item — remains the recommended, current pattern for data-driven reporting years later. The custom apiWPPrintSelection/apiWPSetHeader/apiWPSetFooter methods are a tech-note-provided convenience layer rather than official 4D commands, so they should be treated as a reusable sample rather than a guaranteed-to-be-maintained product API, but the underlying WP command set they wrap is stable and still fully supported.
related_updates: 4D Write Pro remains the current document engine (classic 4D Write is legacy); the ORDA-driven print-selection pattern shown here is still standard practice.
